OUR STORY

It Started with a Vision

We started with a vision to make luxury fragrance and beauty products accessible for everyone. Our goal is to help you feel confident and beautiful by offering brand-name beauty products at affordable prices - because we all deserve to feel beautiful.

Founded in 1997, our team started selling individual fragrance products on the streets of NYC. The rise of eCommerce created the opportunity for us to take our business national, providing luxury fragrance and beauty products at the best prices to customers across the US. Fragrance.com was born.

We have shipped over 40 million packages and have sold over $4 billion in beauty products. We have 3 warehouses, 400 team members, and 4 Retail Stores. We currently carry over 40,000 brand name fragrances, skincare, makeup, haircare, aromatherapy, and candles all at more accessible prices.

While we've grown, we've stayed true to our founding values. We treat our people and our customers like family. We seek out the best perfumes, colognes, and beauty products. We have built our passionate customer service team to help ensure your shopping experience is enjoyable. Fragrance.com has received an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau and we have over 75,000 5 Star Customer Reviews.

We've come a long way, but we're not done. We continue to pursue opportunities to innovate, expand our offerings, improve our sustainability, and elevate our customer experience.

We built Fragrance.com for you - because you deserve it.
